description: Scalar contraction factorization regression and conditional collection fix

synthetic_conditional_collection.scope: Synthetic scalar conditional collection with four condition groups; each payload is body(index)*(a+b)^7 and one opaque reciprocal spectator. This does not reproduce the full production expression shape.
synthetic_conditional_collection.timing_boundary: Input construction measured separately. Whole routes include initial selector scan, unchanged theta/unary-IF normalizations, and final grouping. New grouping repeats the bulk bottom-up pass to exact stability to handle callbacks. Grouping-only explicitly supplemental and includes the fixed-point loop. Result equality checks, symbol registration and expected-result construction are outside clocks.
synthetic_conditional_collection.samples: One warmup and three timed samples per route/size, all retained; old/new run order alternated.
synthetic_conditional_collection.supersedes: v1/summary.json; original single-pass implementation lacked callback fixed-point behavior

protocol.shared_host_qualification: Other users/CI jobs may run with unrestricted affinity; paired alternating samples use CPU12, diagnostics16-19, own builds28-31. CPU pinning is not exclusive CPU reservation.
protocol.clock: complete fresh process CPU and wall, including startup; input checks excluded
protocol.check: integration summaries and max-weight coordinates, not every pointwise sample

coarse_summary.scope: Original complete GL000 generation plus 20-sample integration, one warmup/build excluded, three alternating measured pairs, same CPU12/profile/dependency/input/seed. Shared host; source/binary verification excluded from clocks. Coarse stages are rounded console durations, not fine-grained profiles. Broad symbolica_eval stage includes Rust expression preparation. Numerical checks compare integration summaries and max-weight coordinates, not all pointwise samples.

diagnostic_capture.timing_boundary: Separate generation/export diagnostic runs with retained expressions; stage timings are not parts of the paired whole-command samples.
